strategies.name: 200-session time-series momentum
strategies.reason: Past results are steady but thin, and no forward record exists yet.

limitations: One instrument family only, so the record cannot be separated from that market's own drift.
Costs assume a fixed four basis points; real fills were not measured.
Surviving periods only — instruments that stopped trading were dropped.

blockers: Forward records have not started, so nothing has been graded outside the past sample.
invalidation: The edge disappears once realistic costs rise above six basis points per trade.
The result depends on a handful of sessions; dropping the best ten sessions removes it.

strategies.name: Two-session RSI oversold re-entry
strategies.reason: The past record is short, wide and sensitive to the cost assumption.

limitations: Turnover is high, so the result is dominated by the assumed cost.
Only two sessions of holding period, so one adverse session erases a run of gains.

blockers: The edge is smaller than the assumed transaction cost at realistic fills.
invalidation: Any cost above five basis points per trade removes the entire past result.

limitations: These are past-record results only. No candidate has been graded on forward or live outcomes.
